title: Dragging with capture
description:
Model dragging a box with the mouse, keeping mouse messages even when the cursor leaves the window.

```
down at (50, 50) inside box -> capture, dragging
move to (90, 70)             -> box moved by (40, 20)
move to (-20, 10) (outside)  -> still dragging (captured)
up                           -> release capture, drop
```
hints: On down: `m_offsetX = x - box.x;` and on move: `box.x = x - m_offsetX;` (lesson 2.02).
In real code, `SetCapture(hwnd)` on `WM_LBUTTONDOWN` and `ReleaseCapture()` on `WM_LBUTTONUP`.
requirements: A box with a position; pressing inside it starts a drag and remembers the offset from its corner.
While captured, moves update the box even outside the window; without capture they would stop.
Losing capture (`WM_CAPTURECHANGED`) cancels the drag and puts the box back.
stretch: Only start dragging after the mouse moved 4 pixels (`GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXDRAG)`).
